summary: Choose a unit u so small that, for every z ∈ s, all points p(z) + u·r (r ∈ Rⁿ) lie in the neighbourhood of hf and u·(p(z) + u·r) ∈ Rⁿ. Put Φ(x) = max{c(z) : z ∈ s, ∃ k ∈ H, u⁻¹(k·x − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ}. Φ is supported in the single compact lattice u⁻¹·Rⁿ (if u⁻¹(k·x − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ then u·k·x = u(p(z) + u·r) ∈ Rⁿ by the choice of u, and k preserves Rⁿ), invariant under translation by u·Rⁿ and under H (H preserves Rⁿ), Φ ≤ f by hf, and Φ(p(z)) ≥ c(z) (k = 1).

steps.claim: Since almost every element of A is a unit, the units are dense, so 0 is a limit of units; by compactness of Rⁿ (intVectors_open_compact_vol) and hf, for b near 0 every point p(z) + b·r (z ∈ s, r ∈ Rⁿ) is in the neighbourhood of hf and b·(p(z) + b·r) ∈ Rⁿ. Take such a unit u (e: the orbit condition at p(z) + u·r).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, e, u, rfl⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 (Measure.dense_of_ae P.ae_isUnit 0) _
    (s.eventually_all.2 fun z k ↦ P.intVectors_open_compact_vol.2.1.eventually_forall_mem (fun b r ↦
    (_ + b • r, b • (p z + b • r))) _ fun _ _ ↦
    prod_mem_nhds (by simpa using! hf z k) (P.intVectors_open_compact_vol.1.mem_nhds (by simp)))

steps.claim: Restate e for every x with u⁻¹(x − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ: c(z) ≤ f(y) whenever k·y = x, k ∈ H.
steps.lean: replace e z k x := e z k (u⁻¹ • (x - p z))

steps.claim: M: for k ∈ H (an integral invertible matrix by i) and a unit b: k·(b·x) ∈ Rⁿ ⟺ b·x ∈ Rⁿ (mulVec_mem_intVectors_iff).
steps.lean: have M (k : H) (b : Aˣ) x := k.1.1.1.mulVec_smul b x ▸ mulVec_mem_intVectors_iff (i k.2)

steps.claim: Rewrite e and M with scalar actions of units (simp).

Take Φ(x) = sup{c(z) : z ∈ s, ∃ k ∈ H, u⁻¹(k·x − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ}. Compact support: the support lies in the single compact set u⁻¹·Rⁿ (HasCompactSupport.intro with the compact u⁻¹·Rⁿ): Φ(x) ≠ 0 gives z ∈ s and k ∈ H with k·x = p(z) + u·r, r ∈ Rⁿ, so u·k·x ∈ Rⁿ by the choice of u (step 1), hence u·x ∈ Rⁿ (k is integral and invertible, M); local constancy: for v with u⁻¹v ∈ Rⁿ (a neighbourhood of 0) u⁻¹(k(x + v) − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ ⟺ u⁻¹(kx − p(z)) ∈ Rⁿ (M); H-invariance: reindex k ↦ k·k' (Equiv.mulRight); Φ ≤ f: each z in the set has k·x = p(z) + u·r, so c(z) ≤ f(x) by e; Φ(p(z)) ≥ c(z): k = 1, u⁻¹·0 ∈ Rⁿ. The remaining set-membership goals are closed by simp_all and grind.
steps.lean:
use fun x ↦ {z ∈ s | ∃ k : H, u⁻¹ • (k.1.1.1 *ᵥ x - p z) ∈ intVectors R n}.sup c, .intro
    (P.intVectors_open_compact_vol.2.1.smul u⁻¹) ?_,
    ((P.intVectors_open_compact_vol.1.preimage (continuous_const_smul u⁻¹)).eventually_mem ?_).mono
    (by simp +contextual [add_sub_right_comm, add_mem_cancel_right, M]), fun k l x ↦ sup_congr
    (s.filter_congr fun z _ ↦ (Equiv.mulRight ⟨k, l⟩).exists_congr ?_) ?_, ?_, fun z k ↦ le_sup
    (s.mem_filter.2 ⟨k, 1, ?_⟩) <;> simp_all [Set.mem_inv_smul_set_iff] <;> grind
